[SWS_DM_01469] Validity period of authenticated roles
⌈
If the call to
ara::diag::SovdAuthorization::ValidateAuthorization returns a value,
then the Diagnostic Server instance shall treat any roles that the application
has set as authenticated via the clientAuthentication parameter as authenti-
cated for the current request and may also treat the same roles as authenticated for any
further request that is processed no later than the time_point returned from the ara:-
:diag::SovdAuthorization::ValidateAuthorization and where the autho-
rization token is identical.
⌋

[SWS_DM_01469] Validity period of authenticated roles
⌈
If the call to
ara::diag::SovdAuthorization::ValidateAuthorization returns a value,
then the Diagnostic Server instance shall treat any roles that the application
has set as authenticated via the clientAuthentication parameter as authenti-
cated for any request that is processed no later than the validUntil returned from
the ara::diag::SovdAuthorization::ValidateAuthorization and where
the authorization token is identical.
⌋

turned from the ara::diag::SovdAuthorization::ValidateAuthorization
and where the authorization token is identical.
